from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section7Scene(TeachingScene):

        COLOR_1 = YELLOW

        loop_center = loop_anchor.get_center()
        
        # Define 4 curved arrows to form a loop
        radius = 1.2

                              end_point=loop_center + DOWN*radius + RIGHT*0.1,

        arrow_3 = CurvedArrow(start_point=loop_center + DOWN*radius + LEFT*0.1, 
                              end_point=loop_center + LEFT*radius + DOWN*0.1, 
                              angle=-PI/2, color=COLOR_1)
        arrow_4 = CurvedArrow(start_point=loop_center + LEFT*radius + UP*0.1, 
                              end_point=loop_center + UP*radius + LEFT*0.1, 
                              angle=-PI/2, color=COLOR_1)
        
        arrows = VGroup(arrow_1, arrow_2, arrow_3, arrow_4)
        
        # Labels for the loop stages
        label_guess = Text("Guess", font_size=18, color=COLOR_1)
        label_check = Text("Check", font_size=18, color=COLOR_1)
        label_blame = Text("Blame", font_size=18, color=COLOR_1)
        label_update = Text("Update", font_size=18, color=COLOR_1)
        
        self.place_at_grid(label_guess, 'A3', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(label_check, 'C5', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(label_blame, 'F3', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.place_at_grid(label_update, 'C2', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        loop_title = Text("The Training Loop", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(loop_title, 'B3', 'D4', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Create(arrows), Write(loop_title))
        self.play(
            FadeIn(label_guess), FadeIn(label_check), 
            FadeIn(label_blame), FadeIn(label_update)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Transition lecture line focus
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_2)
        )

        # Error Meter Setup
        meter_bg = Rectangle(height=3, width=0.5, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(meter_bg, 'B6', 'E6')
        meter_label = Text("Error", font_size=14, color=WHITE).next_to(meter_bg, UP)
        
        # We use a ValueTracker to animate the error level
        error_level = ValueTracker(2.8) # Starts high (max height is 3.0)
        
        # Define the filling part of the meter
        meter_fill = always_redraw(lambda: Rectangle(
            height=max(0.01, error_level.get_value()), 
            width=0.4, 
            fill_color=interpolate_color(COLOR_3, RED, error_level.get_value()/3), 
            fill_opacity=0.8, 
            stroke_width=0
        ).move_to(meter_bg.get_bottom(), aligned_edge=DOWN))
        
        # Knobs (Simplified Neural Network representation - weights)
        knob_circle_1 = Circle(radius=0.15, color=COLOR_2)
        knob_circle_2 = Circle(radius=0.15, color=COLOR_2)
        knob_circle_3 = Circle(radius=0.15, color=COLOR_2)
        knob_circle_4 = Circle(radius=0.15, color=COLOR_2)
        
        knobs = VGroup(knob_circle_1, knob_circle_2, knob_circle_3, knob_circle_4).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.4)
        self.place_in_area(knobs, 'F2', 'F5')
        
        # Indicators inside knobs that will 'jitter' to simulate learning
        indicators = VGroup(*[Line(k.get_center(), k.get_center() + UP*0.12, color=WHITE) for k in knobs])
        
        def jitter_knobs(mob, dt):
            # Rotates slightly back and forth
            mob.rotate(np.sin(dt * 10) * 0.1)
            for item in mob:
                item.rotate(np.random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3))

        indicators.add_updater(jitter_knobs)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(meter_bg), FadeIn(meter_fill), FadeIn(meter_label), 
            FadeIn(knobs), FadeIn(indicators)
        )
        
        # Simulate "Thousands of iterations"
        # The loop arrows rotate, knobs jitter, and error decreases
        self.play(
            Rotate(arrows, angle=-6*PI, run_time=5, rate_func=linear),
            error_level.animate(run_time=5, rate_func=slow_into).set_value(0.4),
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Final lecture line focus
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_3)
        )

        # Knobs stop jittering and settle
        indicators.remove_updater(jitter_knobs)
        
        # Final update: Error reaches near zero, elements turn success color
        self.play(
            error_level.animate().set_value(0.05),
            knobs.animate.set_color(COLOR_3),
            indicators.animate.set_color(COLOR_3),
            arrows.animate.set_color(COLOR_3),
            run_time=2
        )
        
        # Final visual confirmation
        success_text = Text("SUCCESS!", font_size=24, color=COLOR_3)
        self.place_at_grid(success_text, 'A6')
        self.play(Write(success_text), Flash(success_text, color=COLOR_3))
        
        self.wait(3)
